title: Colosseum 1.1.3
summary: Restores the withdrawn 1.1.2 release: the app opens again, launches no longer flash a console window, post-update relaunch no longer exits instantly, and the installer is a fraction of 1.1.2's size.

highlights.title: The app opens again
highlights.body: Colosseum.Activity is registered unconditionally instead of living inside a compile guard that dropped it from release builds and made the window never appear.

highlights.title: No console window
highlights.body: colosseum.exe now builds as a GUI-subsystem app. The console flash behind every launch, a defect since 0.1, is gone.

highlights.title: Relaunch after update works
highlights.body: The updater's relaunch flags were being read as a QML file path and crashing the app instantly. They now reach the code that consumes them.

highlights.title: Slimmed down
highlights.body: The release packager strips dev and test artifacts from the stage and refuses to publish an installer over 300MB.

highlights.title: Hardened, with a home portal
highlights.body: Live deletion and replacement reconcile instantly, stale enrichment can no longer overwrite newer data, and CBR fails closed. A new home portal opens Vault from Colosseum's home screen.

highlights.title: On by default
highlights.body: Watch Party points at a hosted relay out of the box. Joining a room now fetches that room's exact source automatically.

highlights.title: Library tab
highlights.body: A fourth tab, Library, gives the volumes you already own a dedicated home next to Discover.

highlights.title: Catalogue overhaul
highlights.body: New Open Library providers, expanded ranking, and a reworked catalogue store sit underneath Discover and Explore.

highlights.title: ScrollGlide and the chronicle
highlights.body: Grid surfaces carry scroll momentum instead of snapping, and the Update page's chronicle view moved to the top bar, full-bleed.
